title: Restore valid official New Caledonia province boundary evidence
body:
Follow-up from #454. This work is blocked until the parent's reviewed evidence packet merges.

Review exactly the three New Caledonia province IDs below. Current Government of New Caledonia GeoReP source is open-licensed and supports the three province names/roles, but its retained raw polygons are invalid (`Nested shells`) and diagnostic comparisons with Natural Earth show Jaccard 0.819–0.917 and symmetric difference 394–816 km². Seek valid, appropriately detailed source bytes or source-owner clarification; review Organic Law 99-209 commune membership, including Poya's split; preserve the invalid original; never silently MakeValid or substitute a diagnostic clone.

Acceptance: exact source chain/license/vintage/hashes; independently check all three subjects; compare only with documented appropriate methods and limitations; record correction-needed or unresolved outcomes honestly; provide a bounded engineering/source restoration handoff; produce the required evidence-quality manifest and positive/negative scoped controls; obtain a distinct exact-head review; submit one focused PR through the serialized merge queue. No core edit, regional certification, publication, or import.
